title: Exclusive: Nakama Press Licenses Uoto's 100 Meters, Goku Midnight Eye Manga for Release in 2027
content:
Mad Cave Studios' imprint Nakama Press announced on Thursday that it has licensed Uoto 's 100 Meters ( Hyakuemu ) manga, and will release the first two volumes in 2027. Nakama Press will release the manga's first volume on February 17 and the second volume on April 27. Additionally, Nakama Press licensed Buichi Terasawa 's Goku - Midnight Eye manga, and will release the first volume on March 2. Nakama Press also confirmed with ANN that the new release date for Samurai Pizza Cats , a new 200-page middle-grade comic inspired by the Samurai Pizza Cats ( Kyatto-Ninden Teyandee ) anime, is December 8. The comic was first announced for release on April 7 of this year.

The company shared a cover and pages in English for 100 Meters .

Nakama Press describes 100 Meters manga 's story:

In 100 Meters , Togashi, a naturally gifted sprinter, has always outrun everything around him—until he meets a rival who challenges not just his speed, but his understanding of what it means to win. As their paths continue to cross from childhood into adolescence, what begins as a simple race evolves into an intense, psychological rivalry. Driven by talent, obsession, and the desire to prove themselves, both runners are pushed to their limits both on and off the track.

Uoto ( Orb: On the Movements of the Earth ) launched the manga in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app in November 2018 as Uoto 's first series, and Kodansha published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume digitally in October 2019.

The manga's anime film adaptation premiered in Japan in September 2025. The film ranked #8 in its opening weekend, and earned 102,666,040 yen (about US$694,700) in its first three days. GKIDS screened the film in October 2025 in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub . The film also screened in Los Angeles that October. The film won the runner-up award for Best Animated Film at the Florida Film Critics Circle Awards in 2025. Netflix began streaming the film with Japanese audio and English subtitles in December 2025.

Nakama Press describes Goku - Midnight Eye 's story:

After a brutal attack leaves him with a cybernetic eye, private investigator Goku gains the ability to hack any system with a glance. But in a world of high-tech crime and shadowy conspiracies, every answer comes at a cost—and the deeper he looks, the more dangerous the truth becomes. Goku, a hard-boiled private investigator in a near-future Tokyo where crime, corruption, and advanced technology collide, gains a powerful cybernetic eye that allows him to interface directly with computers. After a near-fatal encounter, he gains an edge in a world where information is the ultimate weapon. As he takes on dangerous cases that blur the line between human and machine, Goku is drawn deeper into a conspiracy that threatens to reshape the city itself.

Terasawa's three-volume manga originally launched in 1987. Yoshiaki Kawajiri directed the manga's anime adaptation at Madhouse , and Terasawa and Ryūzō Nakanishi wrote the script. The OVA released in 1989 and a sequel also released in 1989. Discotek released both OVAs on DVD in 2017. Discotek then released Goku - Midnight Eye on Blu-ray Disc under the title Midnight Eye Goku in 2023. The release marked the first Blu-ray Disc release of the OVA anywhere in the world. The release included two dubs: one from Urban Vision and one from Manga UK .

Update: Added Goku - Midnight Eye to headline.

title: Spy x Family Teases Jump Festa Update as Fans Wait for Season 4
content:
It’s been a while since Spy x Family Season 3 reached its conclusion, but fans still haven’t received any updates on the anime’s future. The anime premiered its latest season in October last year as part of the Fall 2025 lineup, where it featured some of the fan-favorite arcs. However, the story is far from over, and Season 4 will bring new surprises for fans. While the wait for the anime’s return continues, the official X handle of AMNIBUS drops a new visual to hype up this year’s Jump Festa. The visual features the Forger family, including Bond. Additionally, Damian Desmond and Becky Blackbell, who also have major roles in the story as Anya’s closest friends.

The visual was shared along with several other series since AMNIBUS is hyping up their merchandise release during the event. The official X handle also confirmed there will be more updates during the event, although the panel that AMNIBUS is holding will be primarily limited to merchandise and not the anime’s future. However, although the visual doesn’t promise anything regarding the upcoming season, Jump Festa will be a crucial event for fans. As the date of the event draws near, fans already have an idea which series will be holding a stage to share new information, and Spy x Family is one of them.

Spy x Family Might Get a Season 4 Update During Jump Festa 2027

While there’s been no official confirmation as to what the announcement will be, we can expect the anime to finally greenlight the fourth season. Even after almost a year since Season 3 ended, the sequel hasn’t been officially announced yet. The official website has already confirmed that Spy x Family will hold a panel at this year’s Jump Festa, which will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026. The anime will hold a panel at Super Stage along with major series such as One Piece, My Hero Academia, Demon Slayer , and more. Jump Festa is the largest annual convention held by Shueisha, as it focuses on new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. However, for global fans who can’t visit Tokyo, the most exciting part of this event is waiting for all the new anime information that is announced each year.

What to Expect From Spy x Family Season 4

The upcoming season will be even more exciting, as it is expected to adapt the Term Finals, Love and War, and Term Break Arcs, each offering its own set of plot twists and heartbreaking moments. However, since the episode count hasn’t been revealed yet, it’s impossible to determine how many arcs will be covered. The Term Break Arc is by far the most important part of the story, where it will reveal a shocking truth about Donovan Desmond. The story has already taken a huge turn in the latest season as it sheds light on Loid’s past and the reason why he is so dedicated to his work as a spy. However, the story has yet to answer many questions regarding Anya’s past and her involvement in Project Apple. The upcoming season will bring fans one step closer to the truth as Operation Strix continues.

title: Yūichirō Momose, Hina Hinata's Bagudan Manga Ends on November 24
content:
The December issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Dessert magazine announced on Friday that Hypnosis Mic writer Yūichirō Momose and artist Hina Hinata's Bagudan: Sono Otoko-tachi Toriatsukai Chūi ni Tsuki (Bagudan: Handle These Men with Care) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on November 24.

The reverse harem comedy manga centers on Tokiko, a high school student who loves otome games. One day, five handsome guys from a game Tokiko is playing gets reincarnated and become her classmates. Tokiko is thrilled with this twist, but things take a strange turn when the boys' heart-throbbing gestures and charm in the game make her other classmates cringe.

The manga launched in Monthly Dessert on March 24. The manga's first compiled book volume shipped on July 13.

Momose and artist Shiwasu Hoshikawa launched a new manga titled Gyakusatsu Kigen (Genocide Origin) in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine on May 25.

Momose launched the Datewars project in August 2025, with Hanaharu Naruko ( Kamichu! , Gargantia on the Verdurous Planet , Kandagawa Jet Girls ) as character designer, and Mino as music producer, video creator, and music commentator. The "timeless music IP project" aims to bring new life to musical styles from the 70s to the 2000s, and will involve 14 voice actresses, with plans for the franchise to expand into manga, anime, mobile games, concerts, films, and stage events.

Momose is the main scenario writer for Hypnosis Mic . King Records ' rap-themed project features voice actors who rap in the personas of original characters, and it launched in September 2017. Hypnosis Mic 's first full album Enter the Hypnosis Microphone launched in April 2018. The group earned the top spot as the most popular voice actor Twitter account in Japan for 2018.
author: ANN

title: Takopi's Original Sin Compilation Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the anime of Taizan 5 's Takopi's Original Sin ( Takopii no Genzai ) manga unveiled on Friday a new trailer and visual for the Takopii no Genzai -Arigatō, Mata Ashita- ( Takopi's Original Sin : Thank You, See You Tomorrow) compilation film . The video reveals and previews the theme song "Rabyū" (Love You) by Tele .

Tele performed the ending theme song for the television anime.

The film will open in Japan on November 27.

Cute little alien Takopi lands on Earth. What is his mission? To be taken to our leader? No. To spread happiness throughout the universe!

The first person Takopi meets is depressed fourth grader Shizuka. (Or is it…?) Takopi is determined to do whatever it takes to make Shizuka smile again. But his misguided attempts to help her by using his advanced technology to turn back time only result in mayhem and death.

What is the truth Takopi can't remember? And what must the pink alien octopus with a heart of gold sacrifice to truly help Shizuka and her friends…?

The television anime starred Kurumi Mamiya as Takopi and Reina Ueda as Shizuka Kuze. The cast also includes Konomi Kohara as Marina and Anna Nagase as Azuma.

Shinya Iino (director for Dr. Stone , Dr. Stone: Stone Wars ) directed the television anime and oversaw the series scripts. Keita Nagahara (key animator for Violet Evergarden , Sound! Euphonium , Sonny Boy ) is the character designer. ENISHIYA produced the work.

The six-episode series debuted on Netflix , Amazon Prime Video , ABEMA , U-NEXT , and other services in June 2025. The anime won the Jury Award for a TV series at the 2026 Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June.

Taizan 5 debuted the manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ in December 2021, and ended it in March 2022. Shueisha published the second and final compiled book volume in April 2022. The manga is also available in English on Shueisha 's MANGA Plus .

The manga was nominated for the 16th Manga Taisho Awards and the 27th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prizes in 2023. The series received the Manga Kingdom Tottori award at the 51st Japan Cartoonists Association Awards in 2022. The manga ranked at #3 in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook's top 20 manga for male readers list in 2022.

title: Capcom Confirms Data Breach of Over 11 Million User Accounts
content:
CAPCOM plans to notify affected customers going forward. It has already established dedicated customer-support channels related to the breach.

CAPCOM had first detected suspicious activity on Monday and immediately began blocking access and investigating the incident. The company confirmed the unauthorized access that same day and implemented emergency measures. The next day, CAPCOM established an internal incident response headquarters to gather information, and it confirmed what information was affected and reported it to its external Information Technology Security Oversight Committee. Finally, on Wednesday, CAPCOM reported the breach to the Osaka Prefectural Police and Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission. The company continues to investigate the incident.

In the future, CAPCOM aims to implement prevention measures and strengthen its information security framework.

CAPCOM is known for its franchises such as Street Fighter , Resident Evil , Monster Hunter , Ace Attorney , and Mega Man , among others.

title: Manga 'Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki' Ends in Next Chapter
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Desert magazine announced on Thursday that Mika Yamamori 's Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ( In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ) manga will end with its next chapter. The 45th and final chapter is scheduled to be released in the December 2026 issue of Desert magazine on October 23.

Yamamori launched the school romance manga in Desert magazine in July 2020. Kodansha released the 11th volume on September 11. The manga has a cumulative 8.2 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in June 2021 and published the ninth volume on April 14.

Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ranked fourth and 11th in the Female Readers' Top 20 of the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! rankings in the 2022 and 2023 editions, respectively.

A 12-episode television anime adaptation produced by East Fish Studio and Atelier Peuplier aired in Winter 2026. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.

A live-action film adaptation is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on October 23.

Synopsis Every time Yoi Takiguchi so much as lets out a sigh, her female classmates squeal in admiration and awe. She has been dubbed the school's "prince" by virtue of her boyishly attractive appearance and casual disposition. However, she chooses to be indifferent toward the attention she receives and spends her days normally—that is, until the school's other prince, Kohaku Ichimura, waltzes into her life and calls her beautiful.

Kohaku is nothing like a prince—he acts thoughtlessly and does as he pleases. But when he compliments her, Yoi feels flustered, and the way he looks at her gets her all nervous. He is the first boy to acknowledge her as a girl, and her attempts to distance herself prove futile as he seems to have set his sights on her. While Yoi keeps telling herself that it is nothing serious, even she cannot completely ignore the stir Kohaku causes in her heart. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Official manga site: http://go-dessert.jp/kc/uruwashi

Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ranked fourth and 11th in the Female Readers' Top 20 of the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! rankings in the 2022 and 2023 editions, respectively.

A 12-episode television anime adaptation produced by East Fish Studio and Atelier Peuplier aired in Winter 2026. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.
A live-action film adaptation is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on October 23.

Synopsis Every time Yoi Takiguchi so much as lets out a sigh, her female classmates squeal in admiration and awe. She has been dubbed the school's "prince" by virtue of her boyishly attractive appearance and casual disposition. However, she chooses to be indifferent toward the attention she receives and spends her days normally—that is, until the school's other prince, Kohaku Ichimura, waltzes into her life and calls her beautiful.

Kohaku is nothing like a prince—he acts thoughtlessly and does as he pleases. But when he compliments her, Yoi feels flustered, and the way he looks at her gets her all nervous. He is the first boy to acknowledge her as a girl, and her attempts to distance herself prove futile as he seems to have set his sights on her. While Yoi keeps telling herself that it is nothing serious, even she cannot completely ignore the stir Kohaku causes in her heart. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Reveals New Trailer, Key Visual, and Kenshi Yonezu Theme Song
content:
The Apothecary Diaries the Movie: The Late Lady’s Treasure has revealed its latest trailer and a new key visual ahead of its December 11, 2026 theatrical release in Japan. The new preview also confirms that the film’s theme song will be Kenshi Yonezu’s “Haru ga Tomori” (“Spring Lights”). The anime previously introduced new characters in separate promotional videos, while you can watch the new trailer below.

The movie is the first theatrical feature in The Apothecary Diaries franchise and features a new mystery written by original series creator. Norihiro Naganuma directs, with TOHO Animation STUDIO handling animation production. Crunchyroll recently announced the acquisition of the North American and worldwide distribution rights for the film.

You can see the new visual below.

It was also announced that Natsu Hyuga will release a novel version of the movie story, titled The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure . The book will adapt Hyuga’s own original film plot and will include elements that could not fit into the movie itself. Its first edition will feature a wide obi using the movie’s first key visual.

The official film synopsis reads:

The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water. The emperor gives Jinshi an order. He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they’re in pristine condition. She’s beautiful, as if she were still alive. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan. They arrive at a bustling city on the water. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away. “I hope nothing happens…” Jinshi’s premonition comes true. On the day of the concubine’s funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

You can also watch the previous trailer for the film:

Natsu Hyuga writes the The Apothecary Diaries light novel, with illustrations by Toko Shino. The series is serialized by Shunfunotomo. The series has 2 manga adaptations, one written by Itsuki Nanao and illustrated by Nekokurage, and one written and illustrated by Minoji Kurata.

J-Novel Club is publishing the novel in English, while Squre Enix is publishing the manga. The story follows Maomao, a young apothecary who ends up getting sold to the emperor’s palace as a lowly servant. She’s not the type of character who can just stay obedient, so she ends up helping Jinshi, the handsome official at the palace.

The franchise recently also announced its first live-action series adaptation , as well as the first console game . The Failure at God School , a manga with story written by Natsu Hyuga, also recently announced an anime adaptation .

title: The Apothecary Diaries Film's New Trailer Unveils Kenshi Yonezu's Theme Song
content:
The official website for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, presented a new trailer, main visual, and character relationship chart on Thursday. The trailer announces and previews the theme song "Haru ga Tomori" (Spring Is Aglow) by singer-songwriter Kenshi Yonezu :

The film's website also announced that the film's novelization, which Hyuganatsu wrote herself, will go on sale on December 9. The novel includes elements that were not included in the film itself, and the first edition features an oversized wraparound jacket band with the film's key visual.

In addition, Hyuganatsu wrote "Kiro no Himawari" (Sunflowers on the Road Home), a short story about Maomao and Jinshi that serves as an epilogue to the film. It will be included in 1.5 million booklets distributed in participating theaters throughout the country, starting on the film's opening day (while supplies last). The booklet will also include interviews with Hyuganatsu and the cast, and the draft art for the film's teaser visual.

Mariya Ise joins the cast as key character and Bi clan son Mu Qing. Nobuo Tobita plays Bi clan head Birō. Kumiko Watanabe plays Birō's wife Shūu. Hirofumi Nojima plays the Bi clan's eldest son Bisen. (All name Romanizations not confirmed.)

Kenshō Ono plays Kajadan river pirate leader Suija, while Ryōta Takeuchi plays Suija's subordinate Eishō, and Jirō Saitō plays the late former Kajadan leader Kaja.

Miyuki Sawashiro plays the middle level courtesan Ruoqing, who died five years ago in the Emperor's inner palace, and whose dying wish was to have her remains return to her homeland five years after her death. Ai Mikami voices Yinshan, Ruoqing's former lady-in-waiting, and the current attendant of Mu Qing, and a general servant of the Bi clan.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11. Crunchyroll announced on Thursday it has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) to the film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will announce the release date at a later time.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours . Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate manga adaptation titled The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace .
author: ANN

title: Muv-Luv Alternative's Schwarzesmarken Games Get Steam Release
content:
Hiroki Uchida 's original novels focus on the 666th TSF Squadron in 1983, 18 years before the events of the earlier serialized novel Muv-Luv Alternative: Total Eclipse . Both novels are spinoffs of Age's 2006 visual novel software Muv-Luv Alternative .

Age released the first Schwarzesmarken PC game, Schwarzesmarken Kōketsu no Monshō (Crest of Red Blood), in November 2015. S chwarzesmarken Junkyōsha-tachi was originally slated for a winter 2015 release. Age released the game in October 2016.

The 12-episode Schwarzesmarken television anime series premiered in January 2016. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Tetsuya Watanabe ( Strain: Strategic Armored Infantry , Zone of the Enders , Rumbling Hearts ) directed the series at Ixtl and LIDEN FILMS . Tatsuto Higuchi ( CROSS ANGE Rondo of Angel and Dragon , Bakumatsu Gijinden Roman ) handled the series composition, Shuichi Hara ( Alice in the Country of Hearts: Wonderful Wonder World ) adapted CARNELIAN's original character designs, Satoshi Motoyama served as sound director, Evan Call was the music producer, and Elements Garden was in charge of the music. SANZIGEN handed the show's 3DCGI.

Uchida wrote the novel series' scenario, and CARNELIAN designed the characters and provided illustrations. Age's Hirohiko Yoshida is credited as the original creator. The novel ran for 41 chapters from 2011 to 2014 and was compiled into seven volumes. The novel was succeeded by the Schwarzes Marken Requiem light novel series by the same author and artist.
